About Me

Hi, I'm Oto-Obong.

I’ve spent the last 5+ years creating content and telling stories on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and now LinkedIn.

But studying Marketing & Advertising in uni helped me connect the dots. I realised I didn’t just love telling stories. I loved understanding people and paying attention to what makes them take action.

Since then, I’ve had the opportunity to lead a team to win at the Lagos Advertising & Ideas Festival (LAIF) Awards in 2025, complete a Mini MBA at Lagos Business School, and work across social media, LinkedIn ghostwriting, email marketing, and brand strategy.

And somewhere along the way, I discovered what I enjoy most: helping founders make sense of their marketing through strategy.

You already have a business tugging you in a million directions. You shouldn’t have to figure out the marketing puzzle alone.

That’s where I come in.

With me,
strategy is simplified.
